metric_name: Astra reference-based semantic accuracy on LoCoMo categories 1–4
metric_scale: 100 * unweighted mean of binary per-source-question correctness; 1540 questions per arm
deduplication: Only exact source question ID + question string + ordered reference list + complete raw candidate string. No trimming, normalization, fuzzy match, or cross-question dedup. One judgment is mapped to each identical method candidate.
ordering: Unique opaque IDs sorted by SHA256(order-v1 + ID), fixed before judging; no method names in prompts.
failure_policy: Any nonzero exit, missing/malformed final JSON, missing/duplicate/unknown case, tool event, model mismatch, or unclosed batch halts serial launcher. Preserve all bytes. No automatic retry; completed batches are verified and skipped on resume.
uncertainty: Single deterministic ordering and one accepted judgment per unique case. No bootstrap, significance claim, or model-judge reliability estimate.
